candidates.summary: Aikido Security says CVE-2026-111497, the Brotli decompression RCE that OpenAI found during red-teaming and first described as affecting Node.js and Python, now leaves many libraries and applications that use HTTP open to pre-auth remote code execution. Aikido calls the wider variant "HTTP2Shell" and says fixes are not yet available for all affected services.
facts: Aikido advises watching for Brotli 1.2.1 dependency upgrades as they become available.

OpenAI says the flaw allows unauthenticated RCE via malicious compressed data: an unpatched server accepting compressed input can be taken over by a malicious client, and an unpatched client accepting compressed input (such as "curl --compressed") by a malicious server.
OpenAI says the root cause was fixed in Brotli source in February but was not known to be a security issue and had no newer release; Brotli cut new releases and published a CVE after disclosure.
OpenAI names Node.js, Bun and Envoy among software that includes Brotli.
Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince (@eastdakota), quoting OpenAI's Greg Brockman on the disclosure: "This one maybe as bad or worse than the PHP ones. Get used to lots of patching."

related.name: Greg Brockman on coordinating the Brotli disclosure

candidates.summary: China's State Council General Office published guidelines (Guobanfa 2026 No. 29, dated October 16, released October 23) on adapting to AI to keep development employment-friendly. They set 18 tasks in six areas: AI job creation, employment-friendly AI adoption, worker skills, AI-enabled employment services, labor rights and social security, and monitoring of AI employment risks.
facts: Companies are encouraged to explore an "unemployment buffer period" system and to notify affected workers in advance and offer transition support when rolling out AI at scale.
AI application projects in market-access areas that could cause a large employment impact must get an employment risk assessment during review; other AI projects get one as circumstances require.
AI should be prioritized for roles with labor shortages or hazardous conditions, with the scope and pace of AI in labor-intensive industries handled cautiously.
AI employment risk is to be folded into China's mechanism for preventing large-scale unemployment, with contingency plans.
The guidelines call for new AI occupations such as AI trainer and AI engineering technician, AI 'micro-majors' at universities, and a set of AI employment research centers.
They call for regulating AI in HR management, including algorithm-driven hiring discrimination, fake recruitment and privacy violations.
